rows.derivation: Pins the documented SR20 choice (CONFORMANCE DOC-A.1-43: equivalence = same .NET invariant uppercase). 85 (bare form): CURRENCY SIGN 'é'; PIC É9.99 and é9.99 with 1.5 -> [é1.50] both (currency string as written, SR22); PIC Éé9.99 is a legal floating string only because É≡é (§13.18.40.3 SR28), 2.5 -> [ é2.50] (§13.18.40.5 rule 6a). 2002 (PICTURE SYMBOL form): é used as É -> EUR1.50, Ω used as ω -> OMG1.50, ｅ used as Ｅ -> FWE1.50, and ｅ/é coexisting with different strings proves they are not equivalent (else SR21). Negative: é->EUR plus É->USD violates SR21 -> COBOLNET0891 at 2002/2014/2023 (85 has one clause, no PICTURE SYMBOL).

The well-formed boolean arm is already pinned by conformance:2002/directive_expressions (FLG).

rows.derivation: A V=2: V 1 then 'AS 2 OVERRIDE' -> V=2 (GR3). B V=1: 'AS 1 OVERRIDE' -> 1. C V=1: plain 'DEFINE V AS 1' is legal only because the LAST DEFINE (the override) specified 1 (SR2 third arm) - proves the override value was stored. D W=5: W "X" rebound by 'AS 5 OVERRIDE' to a numeric, so the numeric relation W = 5 holds.

The program IS rejected at 2002/2014/2023, but with COBOLNET0901 "'ADDRESS' is a reserved word ... cannot be used as a user-defined word (ISO §8.9)" - a misattributed diagnostic from the grammar falling through (same for MOVE P TO ADDRESS OF W and CALL "X" RETURNING ADDRESS OF W).
